[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. The discovery of gravitational waves: In 2015, LIGO detected ripples in space-time, confirming a prediction made by Einstein's theory of general relativity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Dark energy: Discovered in the late 1990s, suggesting an unknown force is causing the universe's expansion to accelerate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Exoplanet research: Thousands of exoplanets discovered, indicating that planets are common in the universe, with some in habitable zones.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Black hole imaging: In 2019, the Event Horizon Telescope collaboration released the first direct image of a supermassive black hole at the center of galaxy M87.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Cosmic microwave background radiation: Discovered in 1964, confirming the Big Bang theory.
